name: anydoc-cli
description: Inspect a messy local document folder and assemble an approved upload pack via the bundled AnyDoc CLI. Offline packing. Optional Portal token for Tell Jacky.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect a folder and assemble an approved document pack.
interface.longDescription: Use the bundled AnyDoc CLI to inspect PDFs, photos, and Office files in a local folder, show a packing list, wait for the human to approve, then copy/rename/split/merge/convert into a new subdirectory. Packing stays offline. Login is optional for Tell Jacky, Guides, and Remember Me. AnyDoc does not classify documents, does not OCR, does not fill official forms, and never says a pack is ready to file. macOS Apple Silicon and Windows x64. Binaries are not Apple-notarized in this version.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this folder and propose a packing list.
Tell Jacky about an AnyDoc bug or feature idea.
